phase_sentences: In preparation phase I insert trocars to patient abdomen cavity
In calot triangle dissection phase I use grasper to hold gallbladder and use hook to expose the hepatic triangle area and cystic duct and cystic artery
In clip and cut phase I use clipper to clip the cystic duct and artery then use scissor to cut them
In gallbladder dissection phase I use the hook to dissect the connective tissue between gallbladder and liver
In gallbladder packaging phase I put the gallbladder into the specimen bag
In clean and coagulation phase I use suction and irrigation to clear the surgical field and coagulate bleeding vessels
In gallbladder retraction phase I grasp the specimen bag and remove it from trocar
In preparation phase the surgeon inserts trocars and inspects the pelvic cavity
In dividing ligament and peritoneum phase the surgeon divides the round ligament and opens the peritoneum
In dividing uterine vessels and ligament phase the surgeon coagulates and divides the uterine vessels and ligaments
In transecting vagina phase the surgeon incises and transects the vaginal cuff around the cervix
In specimen removal phase the surgeon removes the uterus specimen through the vagina
In suturing phase the surgeon sutures and closes the vaginal cuff
In washing phase the surgeon irrigates and aspirates to clean the surgical field
